answer: Voting and attestation weight is time-weighted: capital must stay locked for 83 epochs before it reaches full strength, and early withdrawal forfeits the accrual. An attacker wanting 103 effective identities must lock that capital for 83 epochs and keep it locked through every signal audit. That is 14 dollars per alias.
